### [`start_lawn_play`](../../../../src/game/start_lawn_play.asm#L6) `$8F30`

*routine*

It sets Gordon's start state ($30 = 8, right, mower at $35/$36 = $51/$cd, $33/$34 = $12/$14), places the sprites ($8f8e) and jumps to $9066.
